title: Squirrel
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- big fluffy tail -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='45' rx='22' ry='30' fill='#E8873A'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='42' rx='15' ry='22' fill='#F5A851'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='38' rx='8' ry='13' fill='#FFC97A'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#D9772A'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='73' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#FFD9A0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='17' fill='#E8873A'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='27' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#D9772A' transform='rotate(-20 28 27)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='27' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FFB87A' transform='rotate(-20 28 27)'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='26' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#D9772A' transform='rotate(20 48 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='26' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FFB87A' transform='rotate(20 48 26)'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='47' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#FFD9A0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2A1A0A'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2A1A0A'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='47' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#8B3A0F'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FF8C6B' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FF8C6B' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M35 50 Q38 53 41 50' stroke='#8B3A0F' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front paws -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='82' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#D9772A'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='82' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#D9772A'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='89' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#E8873A'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='89' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#E8873A'/>
  <!-- acorn in paws -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='80' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#C8A060'/>
  <path d='M39 76 Q44 72 49 76' stroke='#8B5A1A' stroke-width='2' fill='#8B5A1A' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- acorn stem -->
  <line x1='44' y1='72' x2='44' y2='68' stroke='#5A3A0A' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
